```yaml
name: Benchmark & Security Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  # Phase A & General Safety: Linting and Formatting
  lint:
    name: Lint & Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-lint-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-lint-

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

  # Phase B: Benchmark CI Workflow with Accuracy Threshold Gate
  benchmark:
    name: Run Benchmark Suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-bench-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-bench-

      - name: Build release binary
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run Benchmark Evaluator
        # Assumes the binary is named 'waf-detector' or similar based on Cargo.toml package name.
        # Adjust 'target/release/waf-detector' if the binary name differs.
        # The request specifies: Offline evaluator CLI: --benchmark with per-provider P/R/F1
        run: |
          # Ensure benchmark corpus exists (Phase B1)
          if [ ! -f "benchmark_corpus.json" ]; then
            echo "::error::benchmark_corpus.json not found. Phase B1 requirement unmet."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Run the benchmark. 
          # We capture output to check for failures or low scores if the CLI supports exit codes.
          # Assuming the CLI exits non-zero if accuracy thresholds are not met (Phase B5).
          ./target/release/waf-detector --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json

  # Phase A, C, D: Unit and Integration Tests
  test:
    name: Run Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-test-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-test-

      - name: Run Library Tests
        run: cargo test --lib

      - name: Run All Tests (Lib + Integration)
        run: cargo test --all

  # Phase A, C, D: Build Release
  build:
    name: Build Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-

      - name: Build Release
        run: cargo build --release

  # Security Gate: Ensure all checks pass before merging
  security-gate:
    name: Security & Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, benchmark, test, build]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check if all required jobs passed
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.lint.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.benchmark.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.test.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.build.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::One or more required checks failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All security and quality checks passed."
```
